items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 31 at 9:50PM AKDT until November 1 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 9 to 14
inches possible. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph. Blowing snow
possible.

* WHERE...The Klondike Highway, including White Pass

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Conditions will likely
become slick and hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow levels are expected to be around 1,500'.
This will limit snow accumulations for places below milepost 10 on
the Klondike Highway.
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. For the latest road conditions where
available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 31 at 9:47PM AKDT until November 1 at 12:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected for areas with Southern to Southeastern exposures.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 1 AM AKDT to noon AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds are expected late morning
through the afternoon hours.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong could make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 31 at 10:03AM AKDT until November 1 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Additional accumulations between 2 to 4
inches expected. Up to 6 inches possible where heavy snow sets up.

* WHERE...Central Arctic Plains and Central Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Travel may be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A narrow area of moderate to heavy snow will
move towards Deadhorse and Nuiqsut this afternoon. Where this snow
sets up will bring a period of moderate to heavy snow. Some spots
along the Dalton Highway
